findings.title: New headroom_config fields use typing.Optional
findings.problem: code-quality.md (Types And Imports) lists typing.Optional[X] as the pattern to avoid in favor of X | None; the new headroom_config fields at lines 346 and 675 are declared Optional[HeadroomConfig].
findings.impact: Documented code-quality standard is not met by newly added code (the standards audit marks it blocking), although it mirrors the adjacent hedging_config fields and file-local style.
findings.recommendation: Declare both fields as HeadroomConfig | None, keeping the same defaults and sa_column (or confirm the file-local Optional convention is the accepted exception).

findings.title: Migration test pins repo-wide head
findings.problem: test_migration_graph_has_single_head asserts get_heads() == [REVISION], pinning f8bd0b700a64 as the head of the whole repo rather than asserting there is a single head. Another migration test (test_credentialtypes_enum_migrations.py:88-90) asserts len(heads) == 1.
findings.impact: The test fails as soon as any later migration lands on top of this one, even though the graph is healthy, forcing unrelated changes to edit it. Reachability confirmed by reading the test.
findings.recommendation: Assert len(get_heads()) == 1 and that REVISION is among the walked revisions, instead of equality with [REVISION].

findings.title: Subagent headroom inheritance untested
findings.problem: The guide documents that builtin subagent clones inherit the parent's headroom_config (via parent.model_copy(deep=False) in assistant_engine_builder.py:160) and that sub-assistants resolve their own via build_agent(is_subagent=True), but no test covers either; tests only call build_agent with the default is_subagent.
findings.impact: If a later edit resets the field on the clone or switches to a field-allowlist copy, builtin subagents silently stop compressing and the new tests still pass.
findings.recommendation: Add a test that a builtin subagent clone of a parent with HeadroomConfig(enabled=True) and gates on reaches build_agent with headroom_config=ResolvedHeadroomConfig(...), plus a build_agent(..., is_subagent=True) case asserting the kwarg is still passed.
